title: Peter and John Before the Council, The Believers Pray

questions.question: Who were greatly annoyed and arrested Peter and John after they spoke to the people?
options: The priests, the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees
The Pharisees and scribes
Pontius Pilate and the Roman guard
The high priest Caiaphas alone
questions.correctAnswer: The priests, the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees
questions.explanation: Acts 4:1-2 (ESV): "And as they were speaking to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came upon them, greatly annoyed..."

questions.question: Why were the Sadducees particularly disturbed by Peter and John's teaching?
options: Because they were proclaiming the resurrection of the dead in Jesus
Because they were gathering a mob to storm the temple
Because they were claiming Moses was inferior to Jesus
Because they were accepting Gentiles into the faith
questions.correctAnswer: Because they were proclaiming the resurrection of the dead in Jesus
questions.explanation: Acts 4:2 (ESV): "...because they were teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection from the dead."

questions.question: Despite the arrest, how many men had believed after hearing the word, bringing the total number of believers to about?
options: Five thousand
Three thousand
Ten thousand
Eight thousand
questions.explanation: Acts 4:4 (ESV): "But many of those who had heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to about five thousand."

questions.question: When brought before rulers, elders and scribes, Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, declared the lame man was healed by what?
options: "the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead"
"the power of the Holy Spirit given to the apostles"
"the faith of the man himself who believed in Jesus"
"the prayer of the righteous by Jacob's promise"
questions.correctAnswer: "the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead"
questions.explanation: Acts 4:10 (ESV): "...by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead—by him this man is standing before you well."

questions.question: Peter quoted Psalm 118 saying Jesus was "the stone that was rejected by you, the builders, which has become..."?
options: "the cornerstone."
"the capstone of the arch."
"the foundation of the temple."
"the chief support of the wall."
questions.explanation: Acts 4:11 (ESV): "This Jesus is the stone that was rejected by you, the builders, which has become the cornerstone."

questions.question: "And there is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved." Who said this?
options: Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit
John, speaking after Peter
Both Peter and John together
Stephen, the first martyr
questions.correctAnswer: Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit
questions.explanation: Acts 4:12 (ESV): "And there is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved."

questions.question: The rulers marveled when they saw the boldness of Peter and John. What did they recognize about them?
options: That they were uneducated, common men who had been with Jesus
That they were learned men trained in the law of Moses
That they were prophets anointed by God like Elijah
That they were powerful men appointed by God as judges
questions.correctAnswer: That they were uneducated, common men who had been with Jesus
questions.explanation: Acts 4:13 (ESV): "Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were uneducated, common men, they were astonished. And they recognized that they had been with Jesus."

questions.question: When commanded not to speak or teach in the name of Jesus, how did Peter and John respond?
options: "Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, you must judge, for we cannot but speak of what we have seen and heard."
"We obey God rather than men, and will never stop preaching."
"The Spirit compels us; no earthly authority can silence us."
"We die before denying the name of God's Son before men."
questions.correctAnswer: "Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, you must judge, for we cannot but speak of what we have seen and heard."
questions.explanation: Acts 4:19-20 (ESV): "But Peter and John answered them, 'Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, you must judge, for we cannot but speak of what we have seen and heard.'"

questions.question: When released, the believers prayed together. They quoted Psalm 2, asking God to note the threats of rulers "against the Lord and against his..."?
options: "Anointed One."
"holy prophets."
"chosen servants."
"eternal kingdom."
questions.explanation: Acts 4:26 (ESV): "The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers were gathered together, against the Lord and against his Anointed—"

questions.question: After the prayer, what physical sign did God give that He heard them?
options: The place where they were gathered was shaken
Fire descended from heaven upon them
A great wind filled the room as at Pentecost
A voice spoke from heaven assuring them
questions.correctAnswer: The place where they were gathered was shaken
questions.explanation: Acts 4:31 (ESV): "And when they had prayed, the place in which they were gathered together was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and continued to speak the word of God with boldness."

questions.question: How did the early church describe ownership of property?
options: No one said that any of the things that belonged to him was his own, but they had everything in common
Each person gave twenty percent of their income to the apostles
Property was shared only among those who were baptized first
The apostles sold the temple land and divided it equally
questions.correctAnswer: No one said that any of the things that belonged to him was his own, but they had everything in common
questions.explanation: Acts 4:32 (ESV): "Now the full number of those who believed were of one heart and soul, and no one said that any of the things that belonged to him was his own, but they had everything in common."

questions.question: Who sold a field and laid the money at the apostles' feet, and is introduced as a good example of generosity?
options: Joseph called Barnabas (son of encouragement)
Ananias the Levite
Nicodemus who buried Jesus
Philip the evangelist
questions.explanation: Acts 4:36-37 (ESV): "Thus Joseph, who was also called by the apostles Barnabas (which means son of encouragement), a Levite, a native of Cyprus, sold a field that belonged to him and brought the money and laid it at the apostles' feet."

questions.question: The believers' prayer asked God to grant them what as they continued to speak?
options: All boldness, and to stretch out your hand to heal and signs and wonders performed
Protection from the soldiers and rulers of Israel
Wisdom to answer every question raised against them
Patience to endure imprisonment without complaint
questions.correctAnswer: All boldness, and to stretch out your hand to heal and signs and wonders performed
questions.explanation: Acts 4:29-30 (ESV): "...grant to your servants to continue to speak your word with all boldness, while you stretch out your hand to heal, and signs and wonders are performed through the name of your holy servant Jesus."

questions.question: The council could not deny the miracle because the healed man was standing right there. What did they plan instead?
options: To warn Peter and John never to speak in the name of Jesus again
To stone them outside the city gates immediately
To bring them to Pilate for Roman judgment
To imprison them until the feast was over
questions.correctAnswer: To warn Peter and John never to speak in the name of Jesus again
questions.explanation: Acts 4:17-18 (ESV): "But in order that it may spread no further among the people, let us warn them to speak no more to anyone in this name." So they called them and charged them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.

questions.question: With great power the apostles continued to give their testimony. Of what specifically?
options: The resurrection of the Lord Jesus
The kingdom of God and his righteousness
The miracles Jesus performed in Galilee
The fulfillment of all the ancient prophecies
questions.correctAnswer: The resurrection of the Lord Jesus
questions.explanation: Acts 4:33 (ESV): "And with great power the apostles were giving their testimony to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus..."

key_verse_text: "And there is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved."
